Actual Stop and remaining-only recovery

After-only hardware evidence: active job metadata and USB pixels were physically checked by the user. This fixture proves integration with real USB; its Dev Staff name is not a production-authenticated identity.

Failure recovery

After-only, simulated USB through the real helper. No physical output in this failure scenario.

What changed, and why

Intermediate receipt stays provisional

Was

An independent label could be settled after its own completion. Chaining can leave the last label held inside the printer.

Now

Every intermediate page stays provisional until the final feed succeeds. Failures retain all affected copy identities for separate physical review.

Stop has an explicit finish intent

Was

An interrupted chain could leave a held label and no confirmed release.

Now

Stop sends no further label content. It first saves a finish intent, then sends only the verified zero-ink release. Close, error and reload never feed or retry.

Recovery preserves exact lineage

Was

A generic repeated sample made duplicate counts hard to verify.

Now

Fresh A/B/C tests and linked child receipts proved remaining-only output. A/B were excluded when C was continued. Downloadable receipts retain operator, text/QR, timestamps and copy identity.

Verification

  • All five production-encoder packets matched the offline SDK reference bytes; the Stop feed is exactly 59 bytes with the pinned accepted hash.
  • 109 focused tests and 11 real disposable PostgreSQL service/audit/lineage cases passed.
  • TypeScript, touched-file ESLint, migration-free app build, codemaps/docs and whitespace checks passed.
  • Independent safety review: no remaining P1/P2 after fixing passive refresh discarding an in-memory pending completion.
  • Fresh browser page has no console errors; phone-width smoke and tablet dialog/Escape/focus return passed.

Things to know

  • One initial blank per normal batch remains. Stopping early adds a small blank to release the held tail; the A/B Stop test produced two blanks in total.
  • The earlier unlettered recovery count stays unverified because the user forgot it. Its raw receipt was retained; those copies were not replayed.
  • The Brother app was closed. No macOS security settings changed and live debugger capture was abandoned after macOS denied attachment.
  • No application migration, commit, push or deployment. Authenticated managed-preview proof, application of prepared migration 0198, physical mid-transfer cable pull and tape-out remain separate gates.
